title: Hyuga Bloodline and Byakugan Techniques
body:
Every Hyuga inherits the Byakugan Kekkei Genkai. Its starting inheritance is guaranteed, but each character secretly rolls their own permanent Potential (how far the eye can evolve) and Talent (how quickly mastery grows). Not every Hyuga can master the highest techniques. Existing Hyuga missing the old inheritance roll receive their bloodline on login without rerolling earlier lucky characters.

Awakening: at level 25 or higher, Byakugan has the normal hidden 1-in-300-per-round chance to awaken during real combat. The eye does not reveal itself early or grant combat perks until awakened.

Commands: byakugan [on|off|status], byakugan scan <direction>, hyuga list, jutsu all, prac, and perform <technique> [target]. Byakugan is a chakra-upkeep toggle. See enemies' chakra and peer several rooms ahead without bypassing sealed exits or private homes. Active Byakugan (level 25+) improves accuracy and evasion. Gentle Fist techniques directly reduce chakra or stamina and may briefly close tenketsu, preventing jutsu use. Eight Trigrams Rotation and Protecting Sixty-Four Palms grant short-lived defensive effects.

Advanced: progressive Vacuum Palm, 128 Palms, Twin Lion Fists and 361 Palms require combat-earned mastery and level milestones. Only Potential 95+ can reach Celestial Byakugan and Fate Sight at level 100, with substantial chakra upkeep. The mythical Tenseigan Chakra Mode and Silver/Golden Wheel techniques require the absolutely rarest Potential 100 character, level 100, and full bloodline mastery; Tenseigan protection only lasts a few combat pulses before the form ends. These celestial endgame powers are NindoMUD adaptations, not standard clan techniques.

Learning: new bloodline techniques appear on level-up, on login for eligible older characters, and whenever an awakened and active Byakugan grows through combat. Most individual attacks must be practiced once with a teacher before use; Byakugan activation itself does not require that first lesson.
